transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling like everything is my fault. My friend died, and I didn’t call her back when I should have. I had ugly thoughts about her sometimes, too. I keep telling people I’m the reason she died. And I know the Lord is punishing everybody at church because of me.

Do these thoughts about being responsible for your friend's death and about God punishing the church only happen when you're feeling very sad and low, or do you notice them even during times when your mood feels normal?
Only when I’ve been this low. Before my friend died, I never thought the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me. That all started after I got so guilty and depressed these past few weeks.
Have you ever had a period before this—lasting two weeks or more—where you felt this same kind of deep sadness, guilt, or loss of interest in things, separate from what you're experiencing now?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time like this, separate from now.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed very little sleep, quite different from your usual self?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had times where I felt unusually up or full of energy like that.
